data_status: Season 7.1 (Chrono Echoes). Wiki Fandom hanya s.d. Season 3; 8 sinergi (astro_power, defender, dragoncaller, enchanted_tales, kishin, necrokeep, swordsman, swiftblade) ditambahkan sebagai stub unverified karena direferensikan hero pool/komposisi S7.

synergies.name: Aspirants
synergies.season_documented: Season 3 (Cosmic Traders) — data terbaru di wiki
synergies.description: Create a Faith Chest that can be opened once. Gain Faith Points each round (amount increases per round, up to 100 points). Opening the Chest grants rewards based on current Faith Points accumulated, and each Faith Point provides 0.1% extra Skill DMG to all Aspirants.

thresholds.effect: Faith Point increases by 1 per round.
Faith Point increases by 5 per round.
Faith Point increases by 20 per round.
Faith Point increases by 100 per round. Upon opening the Chest, instantly receive the rewards for 999 Faith Point(s).

synergies.notes: Baru diperkenalkan di Season 3 (dibanding Season 2 wiki).

synergies.name: Dragon Altar
synergies.season_documented: Season 2 (Blessing of Embers) — wiki
synergies.description: Generate special tiles on the battlefield. Heroes on these tiles gain DMG Increase and Hybrid DEF, with Dragon Altar Heroes receiving 3 times the bonus.

thresholds.effect: Create 4 special tile(s). Gain 8% DMG Increase and 8 Hybrid DEF.
Create 6 special tile(s). Gain 12% DMG Increase and 12 Hybrid DEF.
Turn all tiles into special tiles. Gain 18% extra DMG and 18 Hybrid DEF.
Turn all tiles into special tiles. Gain 40% extra DMG and 40 Hybrid DEF. Additionally, a dragon descends at the start of battle, dealing True DMG equal to 50% of enemies' HP and stunning them for 3s.

synergies.notes: Dihapus/dihentikan di Season 3 wiki. Dikonfirmasi resmi (en.moonton.com) kembali hadir di Season 7 Chrono Echoes — angka Season 7 BELUM terverifikasi; angka di atas dari Season 2 wiki.
